The colors of the meters stand out a lot in the default theme, and if you're going for a specific palette, or find the colors too saturated, or even deal with colorblindness, being able to change those colors are important. They mean something.
Also, the editor has many settings for colors already. I don't think this is a big addition in my opinion.
